problem: Mode 6 (analyst random-look, drought fallthrough) is a producer with no consumer. Actionable Mode-6 findings are written as self-initiated monitor/analyst/expansions/EXP-NNN.json files + an audience=decider attention-inbox note requesting allocation, but the decider has NO intake path for analyst-self-initiated expansions (grep decider.md for 'Mode 6'/'self-initiated'/'random-look' = zero hits; verified again this run). It only ingests decider-ASSIGNED expansions (Priority 4). Consequences observed: (1) EXP-671 (07-21), EXP-673/674/675 (07-23..29) stranded unallocated 8-10 days until the operator hand-fixed two of them (commit 3415f0f9); (2) ID-collision hazard LIVE at authoring time: files EXP-673/674/675 exist in expansions/ with no tracker entry while expansion-tracker.json next_id=673 and tracker live-max=671 — the next legit allocate-exp-ids.js run would mint a duplicate EXP-673 (the allocator clamps on tracker items + archive only, never on files in the expansions/ dir; verified: grep 'expansions' allocate-exp-ids.js = zero hits); (3) each stranding spawns symptom-issues (ISS-3021 Mode 2b re-surfacing; ATTN-2026-07-26 exp-allocation-backlog note).
root_cause: Mode 6 uses the wrong output channel. The decider DOES drain monitor/analyst/issue-proposals/ every run (Priority 1b, ledger-deduped, verified working). Mode-6 findings should enter there and route through ISS -> curmudgeon like all other work. The self-initiated-EXP path institutionalizes a channel that has no consumer, and additionally corrupts the EXP id space because the analyst is (correctly) READ-ONLY on the tracker.

proposed_fix.summary: Three parts. (1) Re-route: rewrite analyst.md Mode 6 Outcomes so actionable findings emit an issue-proposal file (existing Priority 1b drain) and self-initiated EXP authoring is explicitly banned; update the Mode 6 READ-ONLY paragraph's artifact list to match. (2) Guard: extend allocate-exp-ids.js to include EXP ids parsed from filenames in monitor/analyst/expansions/ in the next_id clamp, permanently defusing the orphan-file collision class (and retroactively fixing the live 673-collision hazard: clamp becomes 676). (3) Drain: convert the two still-stranded Mode-6 EXPs (EXP-671 station mislabel, EXP-673 stale-imminent sweep) into issue-proposal files created at apply time, so they flow through Priority 1b on the next decider run; mark the 4 stale Mode-6 ATTN notes resolved at apply time. NO throttle on Mode 6 cadence (see tradeoffs).

The decider drains this directory every run (Priority 1b, ledger-deduped) and routes the resulting ISS through curmudgeon like all other work. **NEVER author a self-initiated EXP file from Mode 6 (PROP-144, ISS-3033):** the decider has no intake path for analyst-self-initiated expansions — Mode-6 EXP files strand unallocated (EXP-671/673/674/675 sat 8-10 days) and their file IDs collide with tracker next_id allocations because the analyst is READ-ONLY on the tracker. throttle_decision: NO throttle on Mode 6. Considered per ISS-3033's ask (re-route vs throttle vs both). Mode 6 is fallthrough-only — it fires inside an already-scheduled, otherwise-no-op Opus slot, so its marginal run cost is ~zero; and it caught 2 real live-site bugs in ~3 weeks of drought (WIN-044 raw <sub> render, WIN-002 dead Sentman DOI — both operator-confirmed real and hand-fixed). The failure was never the cadence, it was the output channel. Re-route alone fixes the waste; throttling would only reduce the hit rate.
tradeoffs: GAIN: Mode-6 findings reach a consumer within one decider cycle instead of stranding; EXP id space integrity is guarded mechanically; ISS-3021's symptom surface empties; no new pipeline built (reuses Priority 1b — the alternative decider-side intake for self-initiated EXPs was considered and rejected as more pipeline to feed drought busywork, per operator-endorsed direction in ISS-3033). LOSE/RISK: (a) Mode-6 findings now cost one extra hop (proposal -> ISS -> assignment) before any EXP work starts — acceptable, these are drought-time discoveries, not urgent; (b) lint-exp-allocations.js's invariant is NOT extended to scan expansions/ files, so a future writer that bypasses allocate-exp-ids.js could still collide — accepted to keep this PROP minimal; the allocator is the only supported mint path per PROP-106, and extending the lint can be a follow-up if the class recurs; (c) EXP-671/673 proposal files intentionally do not inline the full patch payloads (they point at the EXP files) — if the EXP files are ever archived the pointers dangle, but expansions/ is append-only so files persist; (d) the 3 orphan EXP files remain in expansions/ as unlinked historical artifacts — harmless post-guard, and FUSE cannot unlink anyway.
estimated_impact: Eliminates the 8-10-day stranding class for Mode-6 findings (2 occurrences in 10 days); defuses a live duplicate-EXP-id mint (would have been the PROP-106 defect class recurring); retires ISS-3021's symptom surface; zero new scheduled runs, zero new files to poll.
